# Tatla Electrical Ltd.

> Electrical and low voltage contractor based in Delta, British Columbia, serving residential, commercial and tenant improvement projects.

## Services
- [Residential Electrical](https://tatlaelectrical.com/residential.html): Wiring, upgrades, lighting and repairs for homes, from new builds and renovations to basement suites.
- [Commercial Electrical](https://tatlaelectrical.com/commercial.html): Electrical for retail, office and light-industrial spaces: power distribution, lighting and equipment.
- [Tenant Improvement](https://tatlaelectrical.com/tenant-improvement.html): Electrical fit-outs for new and changing tenant spaces, coordinated with your contractor and designer.
- [Low Voltage](https://tatlaelectrical.com/low-voltage.html): Data, security, access control and audio/video cabling for homes and businesses.
